name: com.privos.calendar-events-demo
title: Calendar Events (demo)
description: Demo: each user's calendar events live in an isolated list; a user sees only their own events, the room owner sees all.

permissions.reason: Identify the active room and the signed-in user so the dashboard knows where it is open.
Find the room calendar list and show the calling user the events they can see.
Create the isolated calendar list on first use and add events assigned to the calling user.

dataPolicy.retention: The app stores nothing of its own: calendar events are list items in the workspace room.

tools.name: calendar
tools.title: Calendar
tools.description: Open the calendar events tab of this room: your own events and a form to add one.

tools.name: calendar_events_create
tools.title: Create calendar event
tools.description: Create a calendar event for the calling user in this room. The event is assigned to the caller; only they and the room owner see it.

roomId.description: Room id; defaults to the room the call comes from
